exposure: Gestational age at planned cesarean hysterectomy (34 0/7 - 34 6/7 weeks vs 35 0/7 - 35 6/7 weeks)
Gestational age at planned cesarean hysterectomy (34 weeks vs 35 weeks)
outcome: Incidence of vaginal bleeding necessitating expedited delivery
cohort: 118 singleton pregnancies with placenta previa, prior cesarean delivery, and confirmed placenta accreta
finding: In singleton pregnancies with suspected placenta accreta, planned cesarean hysterectomy at 34 0/7 - 34 6/7 weeks was associated with a decreased chance of unscheduled delivery due to severe vaginal bleeding.
mod_finding: Planned cesarean hysterectomy at 34 weeks was associated with a decreased chance of unscheduled delivery due to severe vaginal bleeding in singleton pregnancies with suspected placenta accreta.
